*   **Limitations:** Relies on the quality of SfM reconstruction; fails in texture-less regions without confidence filtering [S1, S2, unofficial].

The claim consists of two main parts: 1) The method relies on the quality of SfM reconstruction, and 2) it fails in texture-less regions without confidence filtering. Source [S1] explicitly states that Structure from Motion (SfM) methods like COLMAP 'struggle on textureless areas lacking distinctive visual features' and that depth supervision relies on this SfM data. Source [S2] addresses the issue of unreliability in texture-less regions by introducing a confidence threshold ($U(p) > δ$) to filter pixels, implying that without this filtering, the depth prediction (derived from SfM/pseudo-depth) is unreliable or fails in those regions. Therefore, the evidence supports the claim that the approach relies on SfM quality and requires confidence filtering to handle texture-less regions effectively.
